comments.author: egbog
comments.body_html:
The Baldr Pro has a runtime of 31 minutes according the to in-game tooltip, but the config says

"Flashlight": 1.5,
"VisibleLaser": 50.0,
"Flashlight, VisibleLaser": 1.0,

and the item

"6272370ee4013c5d7e31f418": {"slots": 2, "runtime": 4},

I don’t see how any of this correlates to the in-game tooltip. What even is “runtime”? What unit is that in? The only change I noticed was setting globalDrainMultiplier lower increased the runtime for it

Also a sidenote, traders wont buy gear with used batteries in them, you have to remove the batts to sell which is only slightly annoying

comments.author: ozen
comments.body_html:
The runtime description for tactical devices (such as the Baldr Pro) will be changed, drain now depends on which mode is active.

Runtime in the config is the battery life in hours of continuous use, as stated by the manufacturer, but for tac devs it is unused as stated above. This runtime is mapped to ingame runtime - which is what you see in the description/tooltip.

As for the inconsistency you’ve stated - "runtime": 4" is unused and a leftover from previous code. I just haven’t removed those for all tactical devices yet.

About the traders, I can probably do something about that!

comments.author: egbog
comments.body_html:
So I’m confused on how to actually adjust the battery life. I realize globalDrainMultiplier affects all devices but i only want tac devices to last longer. So I changed “Flashlight”, “VisibleLaser” and “Flashlight, VisibleLaser” but it didn’t actually change anything in the tooltip.

Like I said earlier, the only thing that actually changed the runtime for me was lowering globalDrainMultiplier

comments.author: ozen
comments.body_html:
Try adjusting those drastically. Setting it to 2 is mapped to ~23 mins, 10 is ~40 mins, 50 is an hour.

The way this works is runtime in the config can range from 1 to 100,000, which is mapped to ingame runtime, which can range from 15 minutes to 2.5 hours (with default settings).

Also the tooltip only changes if you change modes while the light is on, else it uses the last active mode.

comments.author: egbog
comments.body_html: Ohhh I see, that makes sense now. I was thinking those settings were in realtime. Thanks for the explanation, enjoying the mod so far
